contracts: (A file or other non-directory target causes the package-validation command to fail closed before validator invocation and is never classified as a supported package directory.) AND (Acceptance evaluation can inspect current source identity and real execution evidence for the verdict and rejects prose-only or evidence-free verdicts.) AND (Exact Cover validation accepts only when every Atomic Obligation has its required independently attributable witness and rejects omitted, wrong-type, or non-independent witness mappings.) AND (Replay verification is unsuccessful unless detached Probe-specific input, actual-target, command, result, and output evidence is independently bound; invalid-package Matrix evidence cannot satisfy that requirement.) AND (S36 验证表明版本文本不能在未重建并核验验证器内容和完整语义依赖绑定的情况下建立信任；仅版本文本或身份不匹配的输入被拒绝。) AND (Terminal rejection is true iff the decision input relies on historical Acceptance or Q8 state and lacks current authorized lifecycle evidence; any acceptance publication or authorization from that historical state is a failure.) AND (The NFR-2 selector accepts a verdict only when its current source identity and the real execution linkage are both attributable; a missing linkage is rejected.) AND (The NFR-6 selector rejects a user-profile-path candidate as current authority.) AND (The S24 selector passes only when its compatibility-specific assertions establish a distinct compatibility result.) AND (The S24 test observes a non-success replay result for the invalid package and no success result is accepted.) AND (The S24 test observes a non-success replay result when the required Consumer is skipped and no success result is accepted.) AND (The S24 test observes that every successful replay result contains independently verified snapshot evidence with authorizes=[]; an absent, invalid, or authorizing record is rejected.) AND (The S36 comparison reports the original native command identity unchanged; a replacement or identity change is rejected.) AND (The S7 test proves account-path writes are rejected and has no successful account-boundary write path.) AND (The S7 test verifies per-case evidence containing the Matrix Case identity and the executed Stable or Candidate subject identity.) AND (The authored S36 selector proves that a resolved Hosted workspace write target is rejected before write execution and no forbidden implementation path is in the Toolchain write set.) AND (The dedicated validator-content selector passes only after its own assertions evaluate validator content; another FR-3 category cannot satisfy this obligation.) AND (The full replay selector observes a non-success verdict for an unexecuted case.) AND (The selected Toolchain test verifies a complete bidirectional Consumer Manifest/repository-call-surface reconciliation, with VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing callers included.) AND (The selected Validator Capability identity and trust source are candidate-external; any Candidate-controlled identity or trust source is rejected before validator execution and cannot establish trust.) AND (The targeted unit selector demonstrates that substituting the validator capability yields a nonzero rejection and no trusted validation receipt.) AND (The targeted unit validation confirms that each evaluated Probe receipt independently binds its own actual target, command, result, and output evidence; absent or reused bindings are rejected and authorizes remains [].) AND (Validation deterministically rejects every retained seed classification outside anchor_candidate, challenge_candidate, and non_baseline_exploratory_candidate, while accepting each permitted value when the record is otherwise valid.) AND (Validation is terminally unsuccessful unless the result records the Miner/Curator exclusion and no implementation authorization; acceptance, scheduling, or authorization is failure.)
selector_intents: Alter the TC-D1 scope policy or request classification so a Miner/Curator request is accepted; the validation must fail because the exclusion contract is missing or weakened.
Configure the S7 boundary fixture to permit an account-path write.
Evaluate a verdict lacking current source identity or real execution evidence and require acceptance validation to fail.
Evaluate an unexecuted case through the success-evaluation path; an accepted success result must fail.
Execute the S7 witness assertion with a non-behavioral obligation missing its deterministic violation witness, or with another obligation's witness reused without independent proof.
Execute the S7 witness assertion with one behavioral obligation missing its observable fault witness while all unrelated mappings remain intact.
Execute the authored S36 boundary test with a Hosted workspace write target and observe the structural write-boundary check fail if the target is admitted.
Execute the existing replay unit selector with an isolated substituted-capability fixture and require the entrypoint to fail closed.
Execute the package-validation selector with a file target and require the runtime rejection marker before package inspection or validator invocation.
Exercise the Probe-oracle verification with valid Matrix invalid-package evidence but without the required detached-Probe binding; verification must fail.
Exercise validate-package with a Candidate-controlled capability identity or trust source and observe trust-boundary rejection.

Provide a decision fixture containing historical Acceptance or Q8 state without current authorized lifecycle evidence; the validator must fail if it publishes or authorizes the new acceptance decision.
Remove the execution binding from a verdict while retaining its claimed source identity and require the behavior selector to reject it.
Run the FR-9 Toolchain reconciliation selector with a manifest/caller mismatch in either direction, including an omitted VDD caller.
Run the S36 source-identity selector with a substituted native command identity and require the structural comparison to reject it.

Submit an otherwise-valid retained seed record whose classification is baseline, accepted_baseline, or another value outside the three-value closed set and require the validation invocation to reject it.
Supply a user-profile authority candidate and require the current-authority behavior selector to reject it.

Target the Probe-receipt assertion with a receipt missing or reusing an actual-target, command, result, or output binding; the test must fail before the receipt implementation supplies independent bindings.
The S24 runtime behavior test omits or invalidates the independent snapshot-verification record on an otherwise successful replay result and expects the assertion to fail.
The S24 selector fails if compatibility is absent, merged into another category, or not established by its own assertions.
The S24 test asserts that a replay result which reports success despite a skipped required Consumer fails validation.
The S24 test asserts that a replay result which reports success for an invalid-package Matrix Case fails validation.
The S7 runtime behavior test removes or corrupts Matrix Case-to-subject attribution and expects the attributable-evidence assertion to fail.
The dedicated validator-content selector fails when validator content is omitted, conflated with another FR-3 category, or verified through a non-behavior artifact.
运行 S36 选择器，保留版本文本而移除或伪造验证器内容或完整语义依赖闭包绑定，并使信任建立失败。
